description: Dependency graph of a Game Kit project: nodes (installed kits with version, provides, requires), edges labelled by capability, conflicts and unresolved requirements. Pass project_id for the installed graph; pass a kit id instead to read the declared requires / provides tree of a catalogue kit before installing it. Call this BEFORE gripforge_gamekit_remove with force. 0 credits.

id.description: Catalogue kit id to inspect instead of a project (returns its manifest tree).

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Default: the workspace’s most recently updated project when id is not given.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_gamekit_dependencies
title: Dependency graph of a project or kit
